title: wss: control-message errors not correlatable
description: StreamEnable/Disable have no id, and RFC 8887 4.3.4 echoes requestId only if given, so a client sending several enables cannot tell which failed. Success signal is inconsistent: draft-atwood-jmap-chat-wss-00.md:193 'wait for any server frame' (proves nothing), draft-atwood-jmap-scene-wss-00.md:437 absence of error. Fix: optional id on control messages, echoed as requestId on RequestError; success is silent.
close_reason: Optional id on StreamEnable in all three; RFC 8887 4.3.4 already requires echoing it as requestId. Success is silent; replaced chat-wss 'wait for any frame' text.
